# One-Sentence Summary

Catalog summary for *Comprehensive Integration of Single-Cell Data*: relevant to single-cell RNA-seq simulation, quality control, cell-state inference, and population-aware analysis. This entry is based on bibliographic metadata and its stated scope; it is not a full-text evidence extraction.

# Scope for simitall

# Agent-Safe Takeaways

- Preserve donor identity when inference is about biological replicates rather than individual cells.
- Report cell and gene QC before clustering, annotation, or differential testing.
- Use truth-aware benchmarks for simulated cell types, perturbations, and eQTL effects.
